provider_stack_options.provider_label: GitHub Actions OIDC + GHCR + Sigstore keyless + GitHub artifact attestations
provider_stack_options.registry_summary: OCI images, web bundles, native packages, and evidence bundles land in GHCR namespaces that treat tags as discovery only and digests as durable identity.
provider_stack_options.signing_summary: Cosign keyless signing binds GitHub OIDC workload identity to every promotable artifact and evidence bundle.
provider_stack_options.attestation_summary: GitHub artifact attestations and cosign-compatible OCI evidence storage carry provenance and SBOM references.
provider_stack_options.notarization_summary: macOS artifacts use Apple Developer ID signing and notarization outside general CI secret storage.
fit_notes: Matches current repo GitHub posture and keeps long-lived signing secrets out of repo variables.
Provides the cleanest portable default while provider selection remains an explicit governance decision.

source_refs.rationale: Release integrity requires digest, signature, provenance, and runtime verification instead of mutable CI dashboards.
Promotion copies exact tested digests forward and never redefines truth by mutable tag movement.
Release candidates require signature verification, provenance, SBOM, vulnerability posture, and notarization where applicable.
Mixed-candidate evidence must be rejected and candidate identity remains hash-based.

provider_stack_options.provider_label: Cloud-managed OCI registry + cloud KMS signer
provider_stack_options.registry_summary: Managed regional OCI registry with per-environment repositories and digest-copy promotion.
provider_stack_options.signing_summary: Cloud KMS or HSM-backed signing keys issue signatures from workload identity without exporting private key material.
provider_stack_options.attestation_summary: In-toto provenance and CycloneDX bundles publish into append-only evidence namespaces.
provider_stack_options.notarization_summary: macOS notarization still depends on Apple Developer ID credentials and a dedicated notarization path.
fit_notes: Valid when procurement requires cloud-native registry and KMS ownership outside GitHub Packages.

provider_stack_options.provider_label: Self-hosted OCI registry + self-hosted Sigstore stack
provider_stack_options.registry_summary: Dedicated OCI registry and append-only transparency stack operated inside Taxat-controlled infrastructure.
provider_stack_options.signing_summary: Private Fulcio/Rekor deployment or equivalent workload-identity signer with internally governed trust roots.
provider_stack_options.attestation_summary: Evidence bundles remain first-party, but operational burden and transparency guarantees must be accepted explicitly.
provider_stack_options.notarization_summary: Native macOS release still requires Apple Developer ID and notarization service interaction.
fit_notes: Only acceptable if platform ownership wants full supply-chain hosting responsibility and audit overhead.
